review: Each summary condition and numeric band transcribed as an independent requirement. Detailed combat chapters, named skill applicability, unstable turret category and stabilized-sight wording remain to be reconciled. No summary entry is claimed executable.

entries.acceptance: Start from the actual weapon/unarmed skill, applying required environmental, suit or riding skill caps before the applicable modifiers. Record the limiting source.
Combined melee visibility penalties stop at -10, or -6 for a character accustomed to blindness. Specific unseen-target conditions can also cap final effective skill at nine.
Move-and-attack, wild swings and the marked blindness/unseen-target cases cap final adjusted melee skill at nine after all bonuses and penalties.

Ranged assessment starts with weapon skill, target size, applicable speed/range and situational modifiers. Combined visibility penalties stop at -10; marked blind/unseen-target attacks cap final skill at nine.

Rapid fire adds one hit for each full recoil multiple in the success margin. Apply actual fired-shot limits and defensive removal using the full rapid-fire procedure; this summary alone does not authorize unlimited hits.
Start from the calculated dodge, block or parry including purchased defense traits, then add relevant modifiers exactly once; eligibility is separate from numeric score.

The table caps accuracy, aim, bracing and targeting bonuses by vehicle stability without a stabilized mount. B469 also exempts stabilized sights; reconcile that wording explicitly with the detailed rule before implementing dispatch.
Choose one target mode: body location, armor gap or weapon. Do not add every listed target penalty or charge a gap penalty twice; ranged attacks reuse the appropriate target penalty.

Choose either random location without an aiming penalty or a specifically exposed location. Fully covered random locations strike cover; partly covered random locations strike cover on one die 4-6. A partly exposed chosen location adds -2.
Apply +4 for determined all-out melee attack; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -4 for melee move-and-attack, also applying final skill cap nine; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -4 for crawling or lying attacker; crawling permits only close reach; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -2 for crouching, kneeling or sitting attacker; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -4 for grappled attacker; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -2 for attacker holding a large shield; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -2 for minor distraction; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -2 for mounted attacker whose mount attacked on its last turn; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -1 for mounted attacker with relative target velocity at least seven; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -2 for striking into an existing close combat; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Apply -5 for wild swing, also applying final skill cap nine; preserve eligibility and expiry from the detailed procedure.
Bad footing imposes -2 or worse, with an explicit authored severity.
Major distraction imposes -3 or worse, with an explicit authored severity.
Use the previous turn's injury shock, normally minus injury up to -4; integrate scale and immunity rules rather than permanently reducing skill.
Weapon strength deficit imposes -1 per missing strength point.
A shield worn in close combat imposes a penalty equal to its defense bonus.
Each -2 voluntarily taken to attack imposes -1 to the defender; validate the detailed minimum skill and eligibility.
Dual attacks use -4 primary and -8 off-hand, or -4 each with ambidexterity. The off-hand penalty is already included and must not be added twice.
Each completed qualifying evaluation turn gives +1, capped at +3, with target and interruption state.
An off-hand attack takes -4 unless ambidexterity removes it.
A rapid strike takes -6 on both attacks, reduced to -3 by a qualifying mastery trait; validate the relevant weapon or unarmed scope.
Total inability to see imposes -10, or -6 when accustomed to blindness, plus final skill cap nine.
An unseen foe imposes -6, reduced to -4 when located within one yard, plus final skill cap nine.
Partial darkness, fog or smoke gives an authored -1 through -9, subject to the combined visibility cap.
Use the actual health condition's attack penalties and restrictions instead of a generic affliction number.
Targeting torso uses +0.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting arm uses -2.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting leg uses -2.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting groin uses -3.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting hand uses -4.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting foot uses -4.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting face uses -5.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting skull uses -7.  Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.

Targeting vitals uses -3. B552 additionally permits tight-beam burning damage beyond the summary's impaling/piercing types; use the detailed eligibility and wound factors. Actual anatomy, exposure and damage rules must be validated.

Targeting an ordinary humanoid eye uses -9. B552 additionally permits tight-beam burning damage beyond the summary's impaling/piercing types and restricts attacks to front or side. Actual anatomy, exposure, body-form exceptions and damage rules must be validated.
Targeting a torso armor gap uses -8.
Targeting a other armor gap uses -10.
Targeting a close-reach weapon or pistol uses -5.
Targeting a reach-one weapon uses -4.
Targeting a reach-two-or-longer weapon or rifle uses -3.
Disarming uses the weapon-size targeting penalty and a further -2 unless using a fencing weapon; retain the subsequent disarm resolution.
Determined all-out ranged attack grants +1.
Ranged move-and-attack takes the worse of -2 and weapon bulk; do not automatically apply the melee final-skill cap.
Bad footing imposes an authored -2 or worse.
Close-combat ranged attacks use weapon bulk as the penalty and validate the actual weapon's close-combat legality.
Weapon injury received last turn gives a temporary penalty equal to injury, capped at -4; keep this distinct from the wielder's own shock.
Major distraction imposes -3 or worse.
Minor distraction imposes -2.
The attacker's own previous-turn shock applies, normally capped at -4, with actual immunity and scale rules.
Weapon strength deficit gives -1 per missing point.
Apply the actual condition's ranged effects and action restrictions.
Checking an opportunity-fire target before shooting imposes -2.
One qualifying aim turn grants the weapon's accuracy; retain target, weapon and interruptions.
Stationary bracing adds +1 only after a qualifying aim turn.
Two seconds of aim adds +1 beyond accuracy; three or more adds +2.
Dual ranged attacks use -4/-8 primary/off-hand, or -4/-4 with ambidexterity, without double-charging off-hand use.
Off-hand ranged use imposes -4 unless ambidexterity applies.
A pop-up attack takes -2 and cannot benefit from aim.
Shooting through light cover imposes -2.
Each intervening figure gives -4 when targeting someone behind them.
A crouching, kneeling, sitting or lying target adds -2 when targeting torso, groin or legs.
A deliberately targeted partly exposed location adds -2, counted once alongside its location penalty.
An actual laser sight grants +1 when its detailed conditions are met.
A scope adds +1 per second of aim up to its rated bonus.
An installed vehicle targeting system grants its specified +1..+3 after aim.
Unfamiliar weapon or targeting equipment imposes -2 under familiarity rules.
Blindness, total darkness or a completely invisible target imposes -10 and final skill cap nine.
An unseen target gives -6 or -4 when its location is known within one yard, with final skill cap nine.
Partial darkness, fog or smoke imposes an authored -1..-9 subject to combined visibility cap.
Light concealment adds -2; distinguish concealment from damage-absorbing cover.
Opportunity fire watching one hex uses +0. Validate the watched region and the actual crossing event.
Opportunity fire watching two hexes uses -1. Validate the watched region and the actual crossing event.
Opportunity fire watching three/four hexes or a line uses -2. Validate the watched region and the actual crossing event.
Opportunity fire watching five/six hexes uses -3. Validate the watched region and the actual crossing event.
Opportunity fire watching seven through ten hexes uses -4. Validate the watched region and the actual crossing event.
Opportunity fire watching eleven or more hexes uses -5. Validate the watched region and the actual crossing event.
Firing 2 through 4 shots gives +0 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 5 through 8 shots gives +1 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 9 through 12 shots gives +2 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 13 through 16 shots gives +3 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 17 through 24 shots gives +4 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 25 through 49 shots gives +5 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 50 through 99 shots gives +6 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.
Firing 100 through 199 shots gives +7 attack bonus. Subsequent bands continue the stated progression; consume actual ammunition, not nominal weapon rate.

The summary moving-platform rows do not separately name an unstabilized enclosed turret in rough terrain/water. Resolve its category from the detailed rules or an explicit author contract before supporting that combination.
An exposed rider hanging alongside and shooting over/under the platform takes -6.
Turning in an exposed saddle/seat to shoot behind takes -4.
After the platform dodged last turn, a nonoperator/nonrider takes -2, or -4 in flight.
A failed vehicle control check gives the failure-margin attack penalty for its actual duration; do not apply it twice through vehicle and combat modules.
A dagger or knife parry takes -1.
A weighted-chain or whip parry takes -2.
Quarterstaff parry gains +2.
Shield or cloak defense bonus applies except against firearms, subject to actual coverage and defense eligibility.

Unarmed parry against a weapon takes -3, with the summary exceptions for thrusts or qualifying grappling/striking disciplines. Verify detailed exceptions before generalizing them to every thrust or skill.
An all-out attack forbids active defense.
The increased-defense maneuver grants +2 to one selected defense type.
Move-and-attack permits dodge/block but not parry under the summary; reconcile any detailed exceptions explicitly.
Crawling or lying gives -3 to defense.
Kneeling or sitting gives -2.
Bad footing imposes -1 or worse as authored.
An unseen attacker gives -4; blocking or parrying additionally requires hearing at -2.
Only close-reach weapons can parry in close combat.
A distraction gives an authored -1 or worse.
Apply encumbrance level as a penalty to dodge, the listed grappling/striking discipline parries and fencing parries; resolve the full named skill applicability against the skill catalogue.
Mounted defense takes a penalty equal to max(0,12-riding skill).
Stun gives -4 defense and retains its other action restrictions.
A rear attack normally permits no defense; peripheral vision permits defense at -2 under the stated summary.
A side or runaround attack gives -2 unless peripheral vision removes it.
A visible aiming dot gives the defender +1 dodge.
The defender suffers -1 per -2 the attacker elected for a deceptive attack.
Two simultaneous weapon attacks at the same target give that target -1 defense; do not apply this merely because an attacker holds two weapons.
A flail gives -4 parry and -2 block, and cannot be parried by fencing weapons.
A short jointed flail gives -2 parry and -1 block, retaining the fencing restriction.
A successful feint applies its victory margin to the eligible defense, with target and expiry tracked.
Parrying a thrown weapon takes -1, or -2 when it weighs at most one pound.
An acrobatic dodge gives +2 after successful acrobatics, or -2 after failure; record the prerequisite roll and usage limit.
Dodging and dropping gives +3 against ranged attacks and commits the posture change.
The optional strenuous defense grants +2 for one fatigue point; enforce its campaign choice and payment eligibility.
Each parry after the first adds cumulative -4; halve for fencing and for qualifying mastery. Resolve combined reductions and weapon scope through the detailed procedure.
Off-hand parry takes -2 unless ambidexterity applies.
Retreat gives +3 dodge or qualifying boxing/grappling/striking/fencing parry, and +1 otherwise; require legal retreat space and the detailed use limit.
Use the actual condition's defense modifier and eligibility.
A defender 3 feet above the attacker gains +1; larger and smaller differences need the detailed height procedure.
A defender 3 feet below the attacker takes -1.
A defender 4 feet above the attacker gains +2; larger and smaller differences need the detailed height procedure.
A defender 4 feet below the attacker takes -2.
A defender 5 feet above the attacker gains +3; larger and smaller differences need the detailed height procedure.
A defender 5 feet below the attacker takes -3.
